submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE freshly drawn full-body animation cel of the exact Water Dragon Scholar boy, running EAST toward screen right. Image1 is frame01 of this new animation and locks character scale, camera, face, colours, outline, virtual floor and costume. Image2 is original E character identity. Image3 is original frontal identity proving the folding fan is held in anatomical RIGHT hand and anatomical LEFT hand is empty. Image4 is the approved primary hand-painted style only; do not draw UI.
Keep exact navy straight hair with tied bun/jade-gold ornament and long blue ribbons, blue/ivory embroidered robes, jade belt ornaments, white pants, gold-trimmed blue boots, open ivory water-dragon fan with black ribs/blue tassel. Fan remains in the RIGHT hand by its pivot. Do not add a second fan, close it, swap hands, change design, or freeze its arm. Natural bent elbows and opposite arm/leg coordination.
Square native 1254x1254 (at least 1024x1024) RGBA transparent single figure, no ground, no shadow, no text, no blur, no sheet. Same locked orthographic EAST profile and scale as image1; keep face facing right. Virtual floor is 95% of canvas height, root x=50%; it is invisible, and airborne poses must retain their air gap. Hip near same x as image1. Body lean 8 degrees forward, no camera zoom. Keep head/hair volume exactly constant. Preserve full figure and ribbon tips within canvas. Clothing flows behind with slight lag. Clean, bright, rounded Daoist chibi painted rendering. Change ONLY articulated run phase to the following, keeping everything else matched.
FRAME 7/16, phase 6/16 of a full 480ms two-step run cycle: First descending flight: RIGHT leading lower leg extends down and forward, sole still 2.5% canvas above floor, LEFT trailing heel high. Body descends slightly. LEFT empty arm forward but returning, RIGHT fan arm back but returning.
